menu.title: Menu
menu.probe_detail: Saves what the camera supports to LENSPRST/PROBE.TXT
menu.save_log_detail: Copies the app's log to LENSPRST/LOG.TXT, for a bug report
status.no_card: No memory card: card profiles, PROBE.TXT and LOG.TXT are unavailable.
apply.done_unsupported: Settings applied. Not on this camera: {items}
hint.distance.head_shoulders: Stand about {m} m away for head and shoulders.
hint.distance.half_body: Stand about {m} m away for a half-body shot.
hint.distance.full_body: Stand about {m} m away to fit the whole body.
hint.distance.environment: Stand about {m} m away so the person fills about half the frame height.
hint.distance.group: Stand about {m} m away to fit the row.
hint.set_aperture_ring: Manual lens: turn the aperture ring to {f}.
hint.manual_focus: Manual focus: use magnification to focus.
hint.manual_focus_distance: Manual focus: set the ring to about {m} m, then fine-tune with magnification.
hint.eye_af_button: For eye focus, hold the button you assigned to Eye AF in the camera menu.
hint.group_focus_middle_row: Focus on a face in the middle row.
hint.group_eyes_open: Shoot a short burst: one frame will have everyone's eyes open.
hint.background_far: Keep the background far behind the person for the softest blur.
hint.focus_on_eyes: Put the focus point on the nearer eye.
hint.subject_on_third: Place the person on a third line, looking into the frame.
hint.horizon_level: Keep the horizon level with the guide line.
hint.meter_on_sky: Aim the centre at the bright sky, half-press to lock, then recompose.
hint.clear_outline: Keep the subject's outline clear: arms away from the body, profile against the light.
hint.bright_background: Use a bright background and soft, even light.
hint.watch_highlights: Check the picture: lower the brightness if the skin loses detail.
hint.shoot_at_their_level: Crouch to the children's eye level.
hint.half_press_to_track: Keep the shutter half-pressed to keep tracking, then shoot a burst.
hint.brace_yourself: Brace your elbows or lean on something; breathe out as you press.
hint.face_the_window: Turn the person toward the window or the brightest light.
hint.sand_highlights: Check the sand and clouds; if detail is lost, reduce EV and shoot again.
hint.landscape_focus: Put the centre point on a clear detail in the main scene, half-press, then recompose.
hint.beach_soft_light: Use morning or late-afternoon light, or open shade, for softer light on faces.
hint.pool_short_bursts: Leave room above the child for splashes; shoot short bursts at the peak of the action.
hint.pool_dim_light: If the pool is dim and photos are dark, try Kids on the move at 1/500 s.
hint.forest_even_shade: Place the face in even shade, turned toward an opening in the trees; avoid patches of sunlight on skin.
hint.forest_bright_leaves: Check sunlit leaves and sky gaps; reduce EV if bright areas lose detail.
hint.forest_leading_lines: Use a trail or rows of trees to lead the eye toward the main subject.
notice.untested_camera: {name}: this profile has not been tested on a real body yet.
notice.crop_mode: APS-C lens on a full-frame body: the camera crops to APS-C.
notice.focal_assumed: The camera does not report the zoom; computed for {mm} mm.
notice.distance_too_close: Closer than the lens can focus; stay at least {m} m away.
notice.dof_insufficient: Even the smallest aperture cannot keep every row sharp; step back or ask people to stand closer together.
notice.min_shutter_watch: This body cannot set a minimum speed for Auto ISO; keep the shutter at {shutter} or faster.
notice.iso_range_unavailable: This body cannot limit Auto ISO; it uses its own range.
notice.iso_capped: Auto ISO is limited to {iso} on this body.
notice.metering_unavailable: Metering mode cannot be set on this body.
notice.continuous_af_unavailable: Continuous AF is not available; using single AF.
notice.face_unavailable: Face detection is not available on this body.
notice.burst_unavailable: Burst shooting is not available; using single shots.
notice.self_timer_unavailable: The self-timer cannot be set from the app.
notice.style_unavailable: Creative Style cannot be set on this body.
notice.soft_skin_unavailable: Soft Skin is not available on this body.
apply.choose_preset: Choose a preset to apply settings
focus.failed: Autofocus failed; save log for details
shot.failed: Shot failed; save log for details
